messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Monday, giving you at least two consecutive days off (plus the weekend).  

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (Sunday + Monday) | Canada’s first holiday of the year. |
| **Feb 20 – Feb 21** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | Monday holiday; long weekend for those provinces. |
| **May 22 – May 23** | Victoria Day (Monday) | Celebrates the birthday of Queen Victoria; long weekend nationwide. |
| **Aug 7 – Aug 8** | Civic Holiday (first Monday in August) | Observed in most provinces; long weekend. |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (Saturday + Sunday + Monday) | National holiday; long weekend for all. |
| **Sep 4 – Sep 5** | Labour Day (Monday) | National holiday; long weekend. |
| **Oct 9 – Oct 10** | Thanksgiving (Monday) | National holiday; long weekend. |
| **Dec 25 – Dec 26** | Christmas Day (Monday + Tuesday) | Christmas gives a long weekend for all. |

> **Pro‑Tip:**  
> - If you’re planning trips for provinces that observe *Family Day* (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island), include Feb 20‑21.  
> - Some provinces also observe *Civic Holiday* on the first Monday in August; Aug 7‑8 is a good spot for a short getaway.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for scheduling your long‑weekend getaways!
